definitions.exact_dd: Floating-point DD with epsilon=1e-15, not symbolic exact arithmetic.
definitions.active_nodes: UniqueTable retained nonterminal nodes. No garbage collection: peak equals final retained count.
definitions.state_nodes: Nodes reachable from the density root. Peak sampled at instruction boundaries only.
definitions.timing: perf_counter simulation plus local gate parsing/cache/statistics; routing, process startup, dense export and fidelity excluded. No warmup; fresh process per repetition.
definitions.dense_baseline: Complex128 dense tensor contraction and partial-trace depolarization, identical routed instruction order and ZZ pairs.
definitions.fidelity: Uhlmann squared fidelity. Raw value is null for a nonphysical state at configured tolerance.
definitions.projection: Hermitian part followed by eigenvalue simplex projection (PSD, trace one), used only for separately labelled fidelity diagnostics.
definitions.qft_input: H-T-H on qubit 0 before the full QFT including final swaps.
definitions.figures: IEEE two-column width 7.16 inches, 600 dpi PNG plus embedded-font vector PDF.
definitions.resource_limits: Limits are per run; timeout includes worker startup. Missing runs never receive fabricated node/fidelity values.
